provenance.name: PMDG 777 heading/track select push switch
provenance.notes: Installed 777-300ER 2.4.147 PMDG_777X_SDK.h defines EVT_MCP_HEADING_PUSH_SWITCH as 69632 + 218 (69850). The 77W_Cockpit_Behavior.xml switch_218_a HDG/TRK PUSH component defines a left press/release. afds.headingSelect.engage sends one SDK left press (0x20000000) and release (0x00020000), sharing the heading dial lock. This is distinct from the rotary EVT_MCP_HEADING_SELECTOR (71812), heading hold (69851), and the HDG/TRK reference toggle (69848). The current reference is preserved. MCP_Heading_Sw_Pushed reports momentary button motion; MCP_annunHDG_HOLD reports hold, neither confirms HDG/TRK SEL. The route acknowledges transport only and exposes no invented selected-mode field. Shared SDK family profiles remain untested for this action. See docs/APPROACH-CONTROLS-AIRCRAFT-COVERAGE.md.

knownIssue: Heading/track select sends the SDK push switch and reports only a request; the SDK has no independent SEL annunciation. Check the flight mode annunciator. Live acceptance is pending on all four variants.
